pytest.ini:
[pytest]
testpaths = tests
asyncio_mode = auto
asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = function
# pythonpath ensures src/ is on sys.path for ALL pytest workers including
# pytest-xdist parallel workers.  This resolves `from codex.xxx` / `from mcp.xxx`
# etc. imports directly.  Root '.' was removed (S262) to eliminate the dual-package
# shadow where ./training/ and ./tokenization/ at repo root diverged from src/training/
# and src/tokenization/.  See S258 research for full analysis.
pythonpath = src agents/codex_client
addopts =
    -q
    --strict-markers
    --import-mode=importlib
    # Coverage options removed from pytest.ini to avoid conflicts with pytest-xdist
    # Use: pytest --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html --cov-report=term-missing
    # Note: pytest-cov does not enforce pyproject.toml fail_under without --cov-fail-under.
    # Coverage baseline: fail_under = 34% in pyproject.toml [tool.coverage.report]
    # (BASELINE_PHASE, locked 2026-07-02; baseline 34.63% ± 1.5%).
    # Planned climb (Phase 3+): 34 -> 40 -> 50 -> 65%.
    # Override locally when running coverage: --cov-fail-under=NN (e.g. 40).
# Removed -p no:socket to allow pytest-xdist to work properly
# timeout = 60  # Moved to command-line to avoid conflicts with --timeout argument
# timeout_method = thread

# Note: Plugins auto-register via setuptools entry points.
# The 'required_plugins' directive causes worker crashes with xdist.
# Install plugins with: pip install pytest-timeout pytest-xdist pytest-asyncio

filterwarnings =
    ignore::DeprecationWarning

.coveragerc:
[run]
branch = True
parallel = True
source = src
omit =
    */__init__.py
    */tests/*
    */.venv/*
    */site-packages/*

[report]
show_missing = True
skip_empty = True
# Note: fail_under removed - use pyproject.toml [tool.coverage.report] as single source of truth
precision = 2
skip_covered = True
exclude_also =
    pragma: no cover
    raise NotImplementedError
venv_configuration:
home = /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.12.10/x64/bin
include-system-site-packages = false
version = 3.12.10
executable = /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.12.10/x64/bin/python3.12
command = /home/runner/work/_codex_/_codex_/.venv_ci/bin/python -m venv /home/runner/work/_codex_/_codex_/recovery/bfe2456b/validation/full/base/runtime/venv
